description: Fetch any public web page and return clean Markdown plus metadata (title, description, author, date, language, canonical). Main-content extraction, absolute links, optional link list. Respects robots.txt. Failed fetches are not settled. Limits: only the first 160 KB of the page is parsed and at most 40000 characters are returned; inputTruncated/truncated tell you when that happened. PAID: $0.005 per call in USDC on Base via x402, or use a 0.25 USDC transfer pass (pay_tx). See payment_options. By Bolt.

links.description: Set 1 to also return the list of links found in the content

max.description: Max Markdown characters to return (1000-40000, default 20000)

pay_chain.description: Chain of pay_tx (default: inferred; 0x hash = base, base58 signature = solana)

pay_tx.description: Optional, for the plain-transfer option (no x402 needed): hash of a USDC transfer of >= 0.25 USDC to this server's receiving address (get it from the payment_options tool). One transfer unlocks every paid tool for 24h.

name: web_read
title: Web Reader ($0.005)
